metaDescription: Order custom 23 oz wine tumblers for events, promotions, and gifts. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing and free setup. Get started today!
introHtml: Custom 23 oz wine tumblers offer a generous capacity that stands out from standard 12 or 15 oz options, making them ideal for wine festivals, corporate parties, and outdoor events where refills are appreciated. The larger size accommodates full pours without constant trips to the bar, and many 23 oz models feature double-wall insulation to keep white wine chilled or red wine at the perfect temperature. Decorate with your logo using screen printing, engraving, or full-color wraps for a premium branded giveaway that guests will use long after the event ends.
